slots.text: Kidz upholds a multicultural, co-educational learning environment. We understand that each child is capable and has a unique style of learning.
Nestled in a stunning 400-acre parkland Kindergarden, Kidz is situated between the M3 and M4 motorways, just a 30-minute drive from Heathrow Airport.
Kidz upholds a multicultural, co-educational learning environment. We understand that each child is capable and has a unique style of learning.
